content.rendered:
?

Isaiah 48:14 MSG
“Come everybody, gather around, listen: Who among the gods has delivered the news? I, God, love this man Cyrus, and I’m using him to do what I want with Babylon.
Isaiah 48:15 I, yes I, have spoken. I’ve called him. I’ve brought him here. He’ll be successful.
?
To many ” onlookers ” Cyrus couldn’t have fitted in God’s plan.
?To many “enlightened” minds, why would God pick him?

God loves you and will do with you whatever He desires so you can bring Him glory.

?Wherever you are today, God will use you mightily.
?He will show everyone what He can do through you.
?
He has declared you are successful, so continually walk in that consciousness.
✔let these words put steel in your spine.
?
?It may not look like it.
?You may even be surrounded by discordant tunes, but with God, your success on all fronts is guaranteed in Jesus name??
????????
